name: hermes-skills-bidirectional-sync
description: Bidirectional sync between GitHub Hermes_Skills repo and local Hermes Agent environment — pulls upstream, syncs skills/memories/profiles to/from local, commits changes, runs audit
schedule_human: Weekly Sunday at 2:00 AM (runs before the 3 AM audit)
script_description: Python script that: (1) git pull upstream with stash/pop for local changes, (2) copies repo skills to ~/.hermes/skills/, (3) copies new/modified local skills back to repo, (4) syncs memories and profiles to repo, (5) commits and pushes changes (gracefully handles push failures), (6) runs audit
output_format: JSON report delivered via cronjob system
guardrails: no_agent=true -- script-only watchdog pattern, no LLM calls, no interactive prompts
enabled_toolsets restricted to terminal + file only -- no web, no delegation, no browser-use
Bidirectional sync: PULL first (github->local), then PUSH (local->github)
Threshold-based alerting: 10 checks, all must pass (no breaches = silent run)
Dry-run support: --dry-run flag skips ALL file operations (git_add_commit_push, cleanup, DEPENDENCY.md writes)
Windows python detection: uses shutil.which('python') not python3 (python3 is broken Store stub, exit 9009)
Path normalization: str(path) uses backslash separators on Windows -- substring filters fail silently; must normalize
File exclusions: sync_skills_push AND sync_skills_pull exclude profiles-export/, memories-export/, .hermes/, .git/, tools/, memories/
Delete safety: sync_skills_push delete phase excludes memories/ directory (CRITICAL FIX -- prevents accidental deletion of tracked memory files)
Duplicate detection: sync tracks duplicates in LOCAL_SKILLS_DIR and logs them; does NOT silently overwrite
Model pinned with fallback: primary=qwen/qwen3.6-35b (provider=qwen), fallback=poolside/laguna-s-2.1:free (provider=nous)
HERMES_HOME environment variable (C:\Users\Owner\AppData\Local\hermes) is used for all local paths
Git operations use commit author hermes-cronbot / cronbot@hermes.local
memories/ directory is TRACKED in repo (NOT gitignored) -- sync_memories copies to memories/ not memories-export/
profiles-export/ and memories-export/ directories are ALWAYS gitignored -- runtime data must never be committed
Git config core.autocrlf=true with .gitattributes text=auto normalizes line endings (CRLF working tree, LF storage)
OneDrive sync: if git fails with 'mmap failed', files may be cloud-only placeholders
Conflict resolution: skill_modified_both=PULL wins, memory=MERGE, profile=local wins
Path normalization: Windows paths use backslash-to-forward-slash normalization before matching
Git state recovery: mmap_failed, pull_failed, push_rejected, merge_conflict procedures with backup
Sync verification: 7 post-sync integrity checks (skill/memory counts, export dirs, DEPENDENCY, git state, audit)
Backup before merge: stash working tree before PULL, restore on any failure

validation_matrix.audit_passed: Post-sync audit reports 0 broken refs, 0 yaml errors, 0 duplicates
validation_matrix.no_orphaned_files: No files in profiles-export/ or memories-export/ after cleanup
validation_matrix.dependency_map_regenerated: DEPENDENCY.md has correct xref count matching current skills

self_healing_actions.git_pull_conflict: Abort sync, alert user, leave working tree unchanged
self_healing_actions.git_push_failure: Commit locally, record push_error in report, retry on next run
self_healing_actions.audit_failure_after_sync: Revert last sync batch, alert user with details
self_healing_actions.orphaned_export_dirs: Auto-clean profiles-export/ and memories-export/ after sync

conflict_resolution.description: When PULL and PUSH conflict, these rules define the automated resolution path

conflict_types.skill_modified_both: Skill file changed locally AND upstream -- PULL wins (upstream is canonical), local changes stashed and notified in report
conflict_types.memory_modified_both: Memory file changed locally AND upstream -- MERGE: upstream changes applied first, then local additions appended if no key conflicts
conflict_types.profile_skill_conflict: Profile-specific skill modified in both -- local wins (profile customizations are user intent), report divergence for manual review
conflict_types.export_dir_conflict: profiles-export/ or memories-export/ tracked somehow -- delete from repo (gitignored), re-export from local
conflict_types.DEPENDENCY_md_conflict: Generated file -- always overwrite with current, never merge

resolution_order: 3. If rebase conflicts: attempt automatic resolution per matrix above
4. If auto-resolution fails: abort, report conflict details, leave working tree for manual resolution
5. Apply stashed local changes after successful PULL
6. Run PUSH: git add -A, commit, push
conflict_resolution.stash_recovery: If stash apply fails after successful pull -- restore from stash@{0}, report as conflict, do NOT push

path_normalization.description: Windows-specific path handling to prevent silent filter failures
windows_gotchas: str(Path(...)) uses backslash separators on Windows -- substring filters like 'profiles-export/' fail silently
Fix: always normalize with .replace('\\', '/') before substring matching
MSYS path conversion is disabled for native tools (git, node, perl) -- pass C:/Users/x forward-slash paths
bash builtin cd supports /c/Users/x but native tools do not -- use cd in bash, then run native tools with $PWD
verification_checks: ALL path comparisons normalize with os.path.normpath().replace('\\', '/') before substring matching
list_repo_files() centralizes exclusion: .git/, .hermes/, profiles-export/, memories-export/, memories/
list_memory_files() normalizes path separators before any filtering
find_skill_files() in audit-skills.py excludes the same directories
generate_dependency_map() skips the same excluded directories

git_state_recovery.description: Procedures for recovering from git failures without data loss

failure_scenarios.git_pull_failed: Working tree may be partially merged. Run: git merge --abort (if merging) or git stash pop (if stashed). Do NOT push.
failure_scenarios.git_push_rejected: Remote has new commits. Run: git pull --rebase, then git push. If local-only changes: git push --force-with-lease (careful -- may overwrite remote history).
failure_scenarios.git_merge_conflict: Manual resolution required. Stash local changes, git reset --hard origin/main, re-apply local changes.
failure_scenarios.mmap_failed_error: OneDrive sync issue -- files are cloud-only placeholders. Pin with: attrib -U +P .git (Windows) or ensure OneDrive is running.
failure_scenarios.disk_full: Free disk space, clear profiles-export/ and memories-export/ temp dirs, clean up old backup files

git_state_recovery.backup_strategy: Before any destructive operation, create a temp backup: cp -r .hermes /tmp/hermes-pre-sync-backup. Restore with: rm -rf .hermes && cp -r /tmp/hermes-pre-sync-backup .hermes
git_state_recovery.safety_net: If sync_hermes_skills.py exits with code != 0, the cronjob sends a CRITICAL alert with the full error log. Working tree is left unchanged.

sync_verification.description: Post-sync verification to confirm data integrity after bidirectional sync. Checks are run AFTER the script completes, using its JSON output + supplementary commands.
checks: Skill count matches: local ~/.hermes/skills/ count == repo skill count (after excluding .hermes/, profiles-export/, memories-export/, memories/)
Memory files synced: ~/.hermes/memories/ files match repo memories/ files
Profile exports tracked: profiles-export/ is empty or nonexistent (gitignored, auto-cleaned)
DEPENDENCY.md regenerated: xref count matches current skill inventory
Git state clean: git status --porcelain output is empty after successful sync
Audit passes: python tools/audit-skills.py returns threshold_breached=False
No orphaned files: profiles-export/ and memories-export/ directories are empty after cleanup
No deleted_files_in_repo: sync dry-run confirms 0 unintended deletions
sync_verification.failure_if_not_verified: If any verification check fails -- halt, do NOT commit, emit verification_failures in report

actual_script_output.description: Exact JSON output fields from sync-hermes-skills.py that the cronjob system evaluates against thresholds
actual_script_output.no_agent_compatibility: no_agent=true so the THRESHOLD dict is evaluated by the cronjob system, not by an LLM
actual_script_output.fields_not_in_threshold: no_merge_conflicts, no_orphaned_files, dependency_map_regenerated, memories_synced, profiles_synced are VERIFICATION checks (run post-script), not field-based thresholds
